text:
ia: FYI I flipped aurora-lite-int6 into a 12% staging canary this morning and our very short-query cohort (<=8 tokens) shows a noticeable Recall@1 drop vs baseline. mostly code-switched EN/ES examples. anyone else seeing this on their quick checks? :thinking:

ops-bot: deploy complete — aurora-lite-int6 v2026-03-23-0930 -> staging (canary 12%). dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/staging/models/aurora-lite/variants/int6

dan: re-ran a tiny quick-eval against the canary with the short_anchor set. command:
```bash
python eval_recall.py --model aurora-lite-int6 --queries holdout/short_anchor_es_en.json --k 1 --seed 13
```
output snip:
```text
Recall@1: 0.59
Baseline (atlas-v3): 0.71
Churn@1 vs baseline: 0.22
```

pri: per-lang micro-breakdown (N=600 each):
```text
lang  baseline  aurora-int6  delta
en    0.73      0.66         -0.07
es    0.69      0.52         -0.17
```

dan: i ran a 500-anchor embed-diff (atlas-v3 vs aurora-int6). mean cosine drop overall ~0.03 but for short ES tails it's ~0.14. attaching small UMAP in the ticket. smells like quantization pushing those small-context tokens away from their anchors.

ia: aurora-lite has a 6-bit per-tensor quant by default in the new quant pipeline. do we have an int8 per-channel build for aurora-lite?

devex-bot: yes — aurora-lite-int8_pc exists and is available in staging. you can route variant traffic and add conditional rules without redeploy: example:
```bash
redwood model set-variant --model aurora-lite --variant int8_pc --traffic 8 --env staging
redwood route add-rule --model aurora-lite --condition "tokens <= 8 and lang in [\"es\",\"en\"]" --variant int8_pc --env staging
```

pri: toggled int8_pc -> 8% + routing rule. re-ran eval on the int8_pc slice with same seed/file.

pri: int8_pc slice result:
```text
Recall@1: 0.69
Baseline (atlas-v3): 0.71
delta_es: -0.02
delta_en: -0.02
Churn@1 vs baseline: 0.08
```

dan: good recovery on the int8_pc slice. p95 latency delta on staging ~+4ms. i'll run a larger overnight (N=5k short anchors stratified by lang) to collect full churn lists and cosine-diff histograms.

ia: two follow-ups to add to the rollout checklist: 1) verify post-processing/whitening parity (we saw earlier cases where missing PCA caused cluster drift), 2) run id-flip synthetic anchors where we slightly mutate suffixes to check brittleness.

sre-jen: tagging SRE — if we ramp int8_pc to 25% canary we'll want a p95 scrape and a circuit-breaker to roll back in <5m if latency or errors spike.

devex-bot: sample commands to change traffic quickly:
```bash
# bump int8_pc to 25% in staging
redwood model set-variant --model aurora-lite --variant int8_pc --traffic 25 --env staging
# rollback to int6 default
redwood model set-variant --model aurora-lite --variant int6 --traffic 100 --env staging
```

ia: proposed immediate plan:
- run 24h canary: route <=8 token EN/ES to int8_pc at 25% traffic
- run overnight 5k stratified eval (churn, recall@1, cosine hist, id-flip rate)
- add per-lang recall@1 alert if delta > 0.03 absolute
- ensure whitening + centering enabled for aurora-lite to match atlas pipeline

pri: will post the overnight artifacts to ticket RED-3841 (nn-lists, cosine histograms, UMAPs). will also include a small script to reproduce whitening used in infra.

dan: quick note — if the overnight still shows edge-case ES regressions, we could try a hybrid routing rule: route tokens<=8 & lang==es -> int8_pc, keep int6 otherwise. lower operational blast radius.

ia: agreed. scheduling a 20m sync tomorrow 09:15 PT to review the batch. thanks all :thumbsup:
